<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="media" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#162D35"/>
      <stop offset=".48" stop-color="#315D61"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#A14A4A"/>

      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#000000B8"/>
      <stop offset=".28" stop-color="#00000012"/>
      <stop offset=".72" stop-color="#00000020"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000D9"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#media)"/>

  <line x1="276" y1="826" x2="280" y2="829" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="276" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF80">Activity</text>

  <!-- Profile -->
  <circle cx="354" cy="823" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="354" cy="831" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="354" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF80">Profile</text>
</svg>
